name: Wick-o'-Wisp
lore: A jack-o'-lantern from Lanternmarsh's autumn festival. Its brave little candle turns scary evenings into generous celebrations.

primary.name: Cinder Candy
primary.description: A visible fireball stops at the first enemy or wall: 18 damage, then burn for 1.5 damage/sec for 3 seconds.

secondary.name: Scary Face
secondary.description: Foes in the forward fan are stunned for 0.85 seconds, then slowed 35% for 3 seconds. Walls block the fright.

special.name: Trick or Treat
special.description: Lob 16 treats over 2 seconds. Each lands for 4 damage, bounces for 4 more, then opens a three-second slow, poison, burn, shock or allied healing patch.

passive: Candle Light: three rotating overlapping circles boost allies' existing critical bonus damage by 50% and healing received by 15%. Grants no critical chance; multiple lanterns do not stack.

technique.name: Lantern Lance

attack.name: Lantern Lance
attack.description: A heavier, longer-reaching ember for 28 damage with shorter, weaker burn. Slower recovery.

technique.description: Trade frequent burns for one heavier, longer-reaching shot.

final_technique.name: Generous Goodies

attack.name: Generous Goodies
attack.description: Lob 16 bouncing treats. Only healing and slow patches; landing damage is halved.

final_technique.description: Trade poison, fire and shock for reliable allied healing and slows.
